{{La Bangu/en}}
__NOTOC__
The dictionary in La Bangu project contains definitions of words in Simple English and simplified dialects of local languages.

In particular in [[jbovlaste]] it reuses Simple English direction for English speakers.

[https://docs.google.com/spreadsheet/ccc?key=0Ahngu1CNj7wddFltdkVpZFNLWlQ5dVN1VVpXSnphVVE&usp=drive_web#gid=7 The current 'Lojban-Simple English' dictionary for La Bangu]. Prepared for translation into other languages with English as the source of translation.

==Simple English==
Simple English doesn't have much common with Wikipedia's Simple English, Ogden's Basic English or Simple Technical English. It tries to present gimste in simple wordage and thus more usable for beginners in Lojban.

==Changes from standard definitions==
*The order or places is the same as in standard definitions so you don't have to relearn.
**However, there are a few changes when the corpus of Lojbanic texts strongly suggests the need in a change and/or leads to misusage. Some of those changes are:
***the third place of '''traji3''' is taken from the fourth place
***'''mabla''', '''zabna''','''satci''', '''konju''' change their place structure
*Not mentioning "by standard" places for most (but not all) {{jvs|smuvelcki}} where they exist. Only less than 25 "by standard" places and 4 "under conditions" places retained and are to be rephrased.
*Strictly specifying what sumti ([[noun]]) type can be accepted in each tersumti (place of a [[verb]]).
**roles of tersumti are specified when necessary
**If several sumti types are possible for the same place all of them are mentioned. '''No other sumti types is possible for this place.''' This allows to better understand the place structure.
*Clearly specifying sumti interactions like in gua\spi language (e.g. "property of x2" place)

There can be sets and ordered sets of objects, events, assertions, numbers, texts. Therefore the dictionary specifies if set or ordered set of any sumti types or particular sumti types is possible for each place of the verb.

==Currently not specifed sumti types==

*realis/irrealis of a place by default. See [[ELG: Subjunctives in detail#Global subjunctivity|Global subjunctivity]]
